description: Supply-chain policy: every direct dependency is pinned to an exact version, and no version is proposed until it is at least 3 days old (internalChecksFilter strict: no branch is created before then).

Automerge is OFF everywhere. main has no required status check, so an automerged PR would merge untested. Patch automerge may be enabled only after a required check (the 'verify' CI job and/or 'Vercel') is enforced on main.
bunfig.toml sets [install] minimumReleaseAge = 86400 so transitive versions bun resolves while updating bun.lock are also at least 24 hours old.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Disabled: lock-file maintenance re-resolves the whole tree in one PR.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security PRs open outside the weekly schedule but are never automerged and still respect the 3-day release age.

packageRules.description: Patch updates open individually. Automerge stays off until main has a required status check.
Minor updates are batched into one weekly PR.
Major updates are batched weekly and always need a manual review.
react, react-dom and their type packages move together so they never drift apart.
Next.js and its companion packages move together.
GitHub Actions stay pinned to commit SHAs and update in one weekly PR.
No package-replacement PRs (e.g. framer-motion -> motion): they carry no release timestamp, so they bypass minimumReleaseAge, and they need code changes. Do these migrations by hand.
Never automerge 0.x packages: any 0.x update may be breaking.
